bead.title: Make sink config default-off and endpoint-safe
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TD-008 CL-2 requires the server sink to stay default-off until explicitly configured, but the current config path can activate delivery from split env and sink setup without a single endpoint validation gate.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:31-37 and 64-65 define the default-on delivery contract with per-queue opt-out, while crates/pqueue-server/src/env_config.rs:131-184 and crates/pqueue-server/src/change_record_sink.rs:13-31 split the config/bootstrap logic.
PROPOSED FIX: Consolidate the sink config contract so endpoint parsing, disabled-by-default startup, and invalid-endpoint rejection all flow through one validated `ChangeRecordSinkConfig` path before any emitter can start.
NON-SCOPE: No Kafka consumer surface, no engine record-mapping changes, no retention-frontier changes, and no claim-path coupling; this remains a background delivery feature only.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestChangeRecordSinkDefaultsDisabledUntilEndpointIsSet` proves the sink stays disabled when no endpoint is present.
2. `TestChangeRecordSinkRejectsInvalidEndpointAndKeepsDisabled` proves malformed endpoints do not accidentally activate delivery.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestChangeRecordSinkDefaultsDisabledUntilEndpointIsSet|TestChangeRecordSinkRejectsInvalidEndpointAndKeepsDisabled'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
